title: aero-create
description: The Create Mod is a thing for Minecraft that's all about building machines and making things work automatically. It has things like gears and belts and machines that use power, which is different from using electricity. You can build complicated factories
body:
Create Mod + Create: Aeronautics Add-on

A powerful combination that expands Minecraft engineering from the ground to the skies.

The Create Mod is a mechanical engineering mod focused on building complex, immersive automation systems using gears, shafts, belts, and rotational power instead of traditional energy systems. It allows players to design factories, machines, and contraptions with a strong emphasis on creativity and physics-based movement.

Create: Aeronautics expands on this system by introducing advanced aerial engineering. Build and pilot fully functional airships and flying machines using Create’s mechanical components, taking your automation and transportation systems into the sky.

Together, these mods let you create fully integrated mechanical worlds—on the ground and in the air—powered entirely by your own engineering designs.
